about.title: About us
about.lead: Mavena Kitchen is a fictional Yerevan kitchen where fast food is made by hand, not reheated.
about.storyText: Every morning starts the same way: the meat and vegetables arrive, we cut the potatoes and start the sauces. Nothing is made ahead just in case — the patty hits the grill the moment you tap Order. That sometimes means waiting five minutes longer. We think it is worth it.
about.value1Text: Every dish description lists exactly what is inside.
about.value2Text: The price on the site is final. Delivery is shown before you pay.
about.value3Text: We deliver across Yerevan — where we can still get it to you hot.
